credit.credit-words: THE PUBLIC DOMAIN SONG ANTHOLOGY | https://doi.org/10.32881/book2

direction-type.words: Ben Selvin's Novelty Orchestra recorded "Dardanella" as an instrumental that allegedly sold more than 5 million
copies in the 1919s. The original lyrics, not produced here, typify how the west viewed the people and
landscsapes of the Middle East as exotic, far off places.
